question: Replication on PHerc0139: in volume 20260102150214, do the public fibers sample denser material than same-region background, and does that disappear when they are displaced?

inputs.byte_rule: every fiber is re-downloaded and must hash-match the census; any failure is RUN FAILED

volume.read: single uint8 voxel per point by HTTP range request; absent chunk = fill value 0 (counted, AGENTS lesson 3); points outside the level shape read 0 and are counted
volume.coordinates: VC3D xyz level-0 voxels; level-1 (z,y,x) = floor(xyz / 2) reversed

sampling.fiber_points: line_points at round(linspace(0, n-1, 16)), duplicates dropped
sampling.shift_note: |offset| = 113 level-0 voxels = 272 um, roughly one sheet period; displaced fibers land on unrelated material
sampling.background: one uniform random point per fiber point inside that fiber's own line bounding box
sampling.wrong_frame_control: fiber points with x and y swapped

statistics: AUC(F vs R): P(fiber voxel > background voxel), ties 0.5
specificity: AUC(F vs R) - AUC(S vs R)
AUC(X vs R) for the wrong-frame control
decision.ci: 95% percentile intervals from a fiber-cluster bootstrap
decision.rule: CONTROL FAILURE if the AUC(X vs R) CI lower bound > 0.5 (a wrong frame would also look supported). Otherwise SUPPORTED iff the AUC(F vs R) CI lower bound > 0.5 AND the specificity CI lower bound > 0; else NOT SUPPORTED.

descriptive_only: per-fiber AUC(F vs R) and the fraction of fibers flagged (AUC <= 0.5) for true and displaced fibers: the review queue
zero fraction per group (masked background or absent chunks)
interpretation_limits: SUPPORTED is evidence that the fibers sit on dense material in this volume's frame. It is not a declared binding: another scan sharing the frame cannot be excluded, and the two 7.91 um volumes have no readable shape.
Density is not papyrus identity, fiber direction, or sheet identity.
NOT SUPPORTED does not prove the fibers are wrong; it can mean the frame or the scale is different.
volume_choice_disclosure: No public PHerc0139 volume passes the strict range check: 4 of 411 fibers reach z 76,959-76,960, 7 voxels past the last slice of 20260102150214 (level-0 z 76,953), which contains the other 407. It was chosen for that reason after the census; out-of-bounds points are kept and count against the fibers.
